title: My child is resistant to participating in Speech Therapy sessions. What to do?
metaTitle: Check how we Handle Resistance during Speech Therapy | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Find out how our therapists at Pinnacle Blooms ensure your child's comfort and engagement during speech therapy, even when they seem resistant.
html: It's quite normal to see resistance, especially in children with autism or sensorial conditions. Remember, each child at Pinnacle Blooms Network is welcomed into an understanding and empathetic environment. Our trained therapists employ various techniques to make the therapy session engaging and joyful, ensuring that every child feels comfortable and looked after during the therapy.
